title: Ariadne Loop public launch
goal: Turn the first working loop CLI into a public open-source project that a developer can understand, run, supervise, and contribute to in under ten minutes
current_state: The core generator, writer, report validator, and supervise command exist; the repository needs stronger naming, public documentation, generated examples, metadata, and distribution hooks
recent_progress: supervise can read JSONL agent reports
supervise can decide continue, stop, rollback, or needs_human
constraints: Keep the compatibility command for existing users
Do not add heavy runtime dependencies
Do not publish before generated examples and metadata updates are committed
Do not hide external-impact actions behind automation
verifiers: supervise produces a decision from JSONL reports
